plot_summary: John Quinn is the protagonist. On Friday, July 26, 2024 at 11:30am, Ali Amin, Alisa Borhman, Akira Muramoto were involved. John invites his friends to a 'history brunch' on Sunday late morning.  1. John messages his friends in a group chat, suggesting that they could meet up for a 'history brunch' at the local Egg & Bagel cafe to discuss post-Napoleonic history. 2. Ali enthusiastically replies in the group chat with everyone. 3. Alisa also replies agreeing in the group chat with everyone. 4. Alisa sends a separate message only to John asking him to make sure it does not devolve into John and Ali monopolizing the conversation with a focus on military history. 5. Akira does not respond to the group chat but writes to John separately saying he's not really interested, sounding slightly exasperated. 6. John answers separately to each of the 3 message threads (group chat with everyone, Alice, Akira). 7. John makes an invite for the brunch adding the people who accepted
